mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have 66 degrees with overcast skies by the Verona Area High School. Expect an overnight low of 64 degrees with rain in the forecast as we enjoy the waning gibbous moon.

The City of Verona Water Utility is beginning cross connection control surveys to prevent water contamination, so you may receive a request to schedule an appointment by mail. Additionally, remember to allow extra travel time if you are near the Hwy M road construction, as closures are in effect through Friday.

Today is a busy day in town. You can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Pizza and a Pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to The Bogey Factory for Trivia Night. Tomorrow, make sure to stop by the ART House for an Art Bar happy hour or check out Hop Haus for their weekly trivia.
In a report from September 21, local police responded to a retail theft after a suspect was caught on surveillance video stealing candy from a retailer on East Verona Avenue.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM, and today's featured flavor is the delicious Double Strawberry.
